purpose: Define the minimum evidence a player-availability source must provide before LevLine may consider historical model research at a pregame horizon.

qualification_tests.stable_identity: At least 99.5% of status rows in each validation season map unambiguously to stable LevLine/nflverse player IDs; unresolved identities remain missing rather than name-guessed.
qualification_tests.target_season_coverage: Point-in-time evidence must cover every intended validation season, including 2025, before a 2022-2025 backtest is allowed.
qualification_tests.revision_semantics: The source must prove whether historical queries expose the status that existed at T-120 rather than only the latest/final retrospective status. If revisions cannot be reconstructed, fail closed.
qualification_tests.timestamp_parseability: At least 99.5% of rows used for horizon qualification must have a parseable source-effective/update timestamp or equivalent versioned snapshot timestamp.
qualification_tests.pregame_only: Rows learned after the tested game kickoff cannot be used to construct that game's availability feature.
qualification_tests.no_realized_participation_proxy: Actual snaps, actual participation, postgame workload and final inactive status learned after kickoff are prohibited substitutes.
qualification_tests.missingness_reporting: Per-season/team/position missingness and source outages must be reported; missing status cannot silently mean healthy/active.
qualification_tests.revision_audit_sample: For a manually reviewed sample spanning multiple teams/weeks/seasons, reconstruct source states at several pregame times and compare with archived/versioned evidence.
qualification_tests.rights_gate: Contract/license must expressly permit the intended automated retrieval, persistence and modeling use before credentialed bulk collection. Public display requires a separate redistribution decision.

candidate_source_priority.reason: Current documentation exposes stable player GUIDs, injury/practice fields and status_date, with historical NFL endpoints; exact revision-as-of semantics still require credentialed proof.
Commercial alternative; historical revision semantics and crosswalk quality remain unproven.
Strong current explainability reference but rendered historical pages alone do not establish stable IDs or exact T-120 revision state.

fail_closed_outcomes: no imputation from realized current-game snaps
current status may remain explanatory context if source/rights permit
